    FAQ

    Good questions deserve clear answers.

    What does VictorySync do?+

    We bring digital marketing and human-led contact center work together. Depending on your agreement, the team can support ads, lead follow-up, qualification, appointment setting, inbound answering, sales conversations, and CRM workflows.

    Where are your team members based?+

    VictorySync is managed from Millstone Township, New Jersey. Trained agent operations are based in Cairo, Egypt.

    Do you run ads too?+

    Yes. Digital marketing work can include Meta and Google ads, creative, SEO, social media, websites, and landing pages. The specific channels are agreed during scoping.

    Who pays the ad spend?+

    Media spend is separate from VictorySync service fees. The ad account, budget, and payment arrangement are agreed before a campaign launches.

    Can you help close sales?+

    Sales conversation support can be included when the offer, training, and handoff process are a fit. We agree the scope before launch.

    Can your team work in our CRM?+

    We can work in approved CRM, calendar, and phone tools. Access and permissions are defined as part of onboarding.

    How does pricing work?+

    Starter contact center work starts from $10 per agent hour. Final pricing depends on coverage, channels, tools, staffing, and campaign scope. Marketing fees and ad spend are scoped separately.

    How do you protect customer conversations?+

    We agree on scripts, access, recording, quality review, and escalation rules with you. People remain responsible for conversations; AI supports summaries and workflows.
